input.rationale: Section 9 is the only warranty provision: subsection (a) (p0056-p0057) is a mutual corporate-authority representation and subsection (b) (p0058) is an acknowledgment about the Globix Agreement that benefits the Company. Nothing warrants that HDI's design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site will be performed to any standard, conform to documentation, comply with law or be free of malicious code, and there is no repair, replacement or refund remedy. With no warranty period and no remedy the clause fails even the fallback on a material term, so an express performance warranty is inserted at the preferred level: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days, unqualified conformance of the Site, each deliverable and each item of software to its documentation for 12 months, compliance with applicable laws, no malicious code, and repair, replacement or refund as the Company's remedy. Section 10.7 already lists Section 9 as surviving, so no survival edit is needed.

ops.text: HDI represents and warrants to the Company that (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting of the Site (collectively, the "Services") will be performed in a professional manner and in a workmanlike manner consistent with prevailing industry standards, for a period of 90 days following performance; (2) for a period of 12 months following the Company's written acceptance and approval of the Site pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site and each deliverable and each item of software delivered by HDI will conform to its documentation; (3) HDI's performance of the Services will comply with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software delivered or used by HDI in performing the Services will be free of any virus, worm, disabling code or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this warranty shall be, at HDI's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software, or a refund of the fees paid by the Company with respect to the non-conforming Services, deliverable or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives no warranty for the development, hosting and maintenance work HDI is paid to perform, so we add a performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services warranted for 90 days, deliverables and software conforming to documentation for 12 months, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with repair, replacement or refund as our remedy.
proposal.summary: Insert HDI performance warranty: professional and workmanlike Services (90 days), deliverable/software conformance to documentation (12 months), legal compliance, no malicious code, with repair/replacement/refund remedy.
